_comment: Provisional thresholds for the inspector release gate. Replace with measured baselines after 2-3 runs on a fixed project. scorecard_gate.py reads this file and exits non-zero when a threshold is breached.

_notes.precision_min: Real runs show 0.94-0.97; 0.90 is a floor that catches genuine regressions. The original RELEASING.md proposal of 0.70 never bites.
_notes.recall_min: The meaningful gate: recall on gold-file bugs. 0.75 is the RELEASING.md starting point.
_notes.not_real_max: TODO: set after baseline runs (tracks false positives the verifier caught).
